title: Retain finite reset backreaction and the physical error algebra
statement: The actual finite coupling Hc=g(XsXr+YsZaYr)/2 becomes a clock/reset exchange and is logical identity. A positive V with ||V||=c=2/gamma+gamma/(4g²) and C*V=-n_q gives s_T>=[1-2c Lambda-4c J-4c gamma_up]T-2c. With g=gamma=r>=18(Lambda+2J+W) and gamma_up/r<=1/36, s_T/T>=1/2 for all T>=1/W, from arbitrary warm correlated nuisance inputs. The coherent bath is retained, not replaced by a telegraph or stationary draw.
